sql.dataView.getAllForCompany: select * from flow.data_view where company_id = :companyId and archived is false
sql.dataView.getUniqueBehaviorTypes: select * from flow.unique_behavior_type where archived is false and data_view is true order by unique_behavior_type
sql.dataView.getOne: select dv.*, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(fields))) FROM ( select dvfc.id, dvfc.display_name as "displayName", coalesce(df.field_name, cf.field_name) as "fieldName", coalesce(df.object_type_id, cot.object_type_id) as "objectTypeId", coalesce(ps2.process_step_name, ps.process_step_name, ot.object_type) as "parentObjectName", coalesce(e.event_name, e2.event_name) as "processStepEventName", dvfc.default_field_id as "defaultFieldId", dvfc.custom_field_group_assignment_id as "customFieldGroupAssignmentId", dvfc.process_step_event_id as "processStepEventId", dvfc.field_to_update as "fieldToUpdate", dvfc.update_first_value_only as "updateFirstValueOnly", dvfc.reset_on_new as "resetOnNew", dvfc.archived, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(childFields))) FROM ( select dvcfc.id, dvcfc.data_view_field_config_id as "dataViewFieldConfigId", dvcfc.unique_behavior_type_id as "uniqueBehaviorTypeId", ubt.unique_behavior_type as "uniqueBehaviorType", ubt.description as "uniqueBehaviorTypeDescription", dvcfc.field_to_update as "fieldToUpdate", dvcfc.data_type_id as "dataTypeId", dt.data_type as "dataType", dvcfc.archived from flow.data_view_child_field_config dvcfc inner join flow.unique_behavior_type ubt on dvcfc.unique_behavior_type_id = ubt.id inner join flow.data_type dt on dvcfc.data_type_id = dt.id where dvcfc.archived is false and dvcfc.data_view_field_config_id = dvfc.id order by dvcfc.field_to_update ) childFields), '[]') AS "childFieldConfigs" from flow.data_view_field_config dvfc left join flow.default_field df on dvfc.default_field_id = df.id left join flow.process_step_event pse on dvfc.process_step_event_id = pse.id left join flow.event e on pse.event_id = e.id left join flow.process_step ps2 on pse.process_step_id = ps2.id left join flow.custom_field_group_assignment cfga on dvfc.custom_field_group_assignment_id = cfga.id left join flow.custom_field cf on cfga.custom_field_id = cf.id left join flow.custom_field_group cfg on cfga.custom_field_group_id = cfg.id left join flow.event e2 on cfg.event_id = e2.id left join flow.process_step ps on cfg.process_step_id = ps.id left join flow.company_object_type cot on cfg.company_object_type_id = cot.id left join flow.object_type ot on cot.object_type_id = ot.id where dvfc.archived is false and dvfc.data_view_id = dv.id order by lower(dvfc.display_name) ) fields), '[]') AS "dataViewFieldConfigs" from flow.data_view dv where dv.id = :viewId and dv.company_id = :companyId
sql.dataView.addFieldConfig: insert into flow.data_view_field_config(data_view_id, default_field_id, custom_field_group_assignment_id, process_step_event_id, field_to_update, display_name, update_first_value_only, reset_on_new, created_by_id) values(:viewId, :defaultFieldId, :customFieldGroupAssignmentId, :processStepEventId, :fieldToUpdate, :displayName, :updateFirstValueOnly, :resetOnNew, :userId)
sql.dataView.updateFieldConfig: update flow.data_view_field_config set display_name = :displayName, modified_by_id = :userId, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.dataView.getFieldConfig: select dvfc.id, dvfc.display_name as "displayName", coalesce(df.field_name, cf.field_name) as "fieldName", coalesce(df.object_type_id, cot.object_type_id) as "objectTypeId", coalesce(ps2.process_step_name, ps.process_step_name, ot.object_type) as "parentObjectName", coalesce(e.event_name, e2.event_name) as "processStepEventName", dvfc.default_field_id as "defaultFieldId", dvfc.custom_field_group_assignment_id as "customFieldGroupAssignmentId", dvfc.process_step_event_id as "processStepEventId", dvfc.field_to_update as "fieldToUpdate", dvfc.update_first_value_only as "updateFirstValueOnly", dvfc.reset_on_new as "resetOnNew", dvfc.archived, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(childFields))) FROM ( select dvcfc.id, dvcfc.data_view_field_config_id as "dataViewFieldConfigId", dvcfc.unique_behavior_type_id as "uniqueBehaviorTypeId", ubt.unique_behavior_type as "uniqueBehaviorType", ubt.description as "uniqueBehaviorTypeDescription", dvcfc.field_to_update as "fieldToUpdate", dvcfc.data_type_id as "dataTypeId", dt.data_type as "dataType", dvcfc.archived from flow.data_view_child_field_config dvcfc inner join flow.unique_behavior_type ubt on dvcfc.unique_behavior_type_id = ubt.id inner join flow.data_type dt on dvcfc.data_type_id = dt.id where dvcfc.archived is false and dvcfc.data_view_field_config_id = dvfc.id order by dvcfc.field_to_update ) childFields), '[]') AS "childFieldConfigs" from flow.data_view_field_config dvfc left join flow.default_field df on dvfc.default_field_id = df.id left join flow.process_step_event pse on dvfc.process_step_event_id = pse.id left join flow.event e on pse.event_id = e.id left join flow.process_step ps2 on pse.process_step_id = ps2.id left join flow.custom_field_group_assignment cfga on dvfc.custom_field_group_assignment_id = cfga.id left join flow.custom_field cf on cfga.custom_field_id = cf.id left join flow.custom_field_group cfg on cfga.custom_field_group_id = cfg.id left join flow.event e2 on cfg.event_id = e2.id left join flow.process_step ps on cfg.process_step_id = ps.id left join flow.company_object_type cot on cfg.company_object_type_id = cot.id left join flow.object_type ot on cot.object_type_id = ot.id where dvfc.id = :id and dvfc.archived is false
sql.dataView.getAvailableDefaultFields: select * from flow.default_field df where archived is not true and not exists ( select dvfc.id from flow.data_view_field_config dvfc inner join flow.default_field df2 on dvfc.default_field_id = df2.id where dvfc.archived is false and dvfc.data_view_id = :viewId and df2.object_type_id in (1,2,4) and df.id = dvfc.default_field_id ) and df.object_type_id in (1,2,4,6) order by df.field_name
sql.dataView.getAvailablePsEventsForDefaultF: select pse.id, process_step_id, event_id, e.event_name, ps.process_step_name from flow.process_step_event pse inner join flow.event e on pse.event_id = e.id inner join flow.process_step ps on pse.process_step_id = ps.id where pse.archived is not true and not exists ( select dvfc.id from flow.data_view_field_config dvfc where dvfc.archived is not true and dvfc.process_step_event_id = pse.id and dvfc.data_view_id = :viewId and dvfc.default_field_id = :defaultFieldId ) order by ps.process_step_name, e.event_name
sql.dataView.addChildFieldConfig: insert into flow.data_view_child_field_config(data_view_field_config_id, unique_behavior_type_id, field_to_update, data_type_id, created_by_id) values (:fieldId, :uniqueBehaviorTypeId, :fieldToUpdate, :dataTypeId, :userId)
sql.dataView.getChildFieldConfig: select dvcfc.*, ubt.unique_behavior_type as "uniqueBehaviorType", ubt.description as "uniqueBehaviorTypeDescription", dt.data_type as "dataType" from flow.data_view_child_field_config dvcfc inner join flow.unique_behavior_type ubt on dvcfc.unique_behavior_type_id = ubt.id inner join flow.data_type dt on dvcfc.data_type_id = dt.id where dvcfc.archived is false and dvcfc.id = :id
sql.dataView.add: insert into flow.data_view(company_id, view_name, display_name, created_by_id) values (:companyId, :viewName, :displayName, :userId)
sql.dataView.update: update flow.data_view set display_name = :displayName, modified_by_id = :userId, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.dataView.getDataView: select * from flow.data_view where archived is false and company_id = :companyId and display_name = :tableName
